# Skillar.ai

> Workforce compliance and skill intelligence platform. Skillar maps the
> skills each role is accountable for, assesses them on a schedule, and
> generates revision roadmaps for whatever the results flag. Built for
> compliance-heavy industries: manufacturing, banking and financial
> services, pharma and healthcare, logistics, IT, construction, hospitality.

## How it works

- Roles are mapped to the skills they are accountable for, with mastery thresholds.
- Scheduled assessments score demonstrated ability, question by question.
- Bayesian Knowledge Tracing flags the specific concepts below mastery per person.
- A revision roadmap is generated covering only the flagged concepts, grounded in the customer's own documents (SOPs, policies, manuals) via retrieval-augmented generation.
- A follow-up assessment verifies the gap closed; certifications are issued and tracked through expiry and renewal, with audit-ready reporting.

## Pages

- [Product overview](https://skillar.ai/product): the full loop, from inputs to certification.
- [Skill Intelligence](https://skillar.ai/product/skill-intelligence): capability mapping from organisation to individual.
- [Adaptive Learning](https://skillar.ai/product/adaptive-learning): post-assessment revision roadmaps.
- [AI Authoring](https://skillar.ai/product/ai-authoring): roadmaps and quizzes drafted from uploaded documents, reviewed by a named person.
- [Analytics](https://skillar.ai/product/analytics): heatmaps, certification status, compliance dashboards, audit-ready reports.
- [Solutions](https://skillar.ai/solutions): views for L&D, HR, frontline managers, and enterprise.
- [Free skills gap diagnostic](https://skillar.ai/skills-gap-diagnostic): a seven-question diagnostic that emails a gap report. No account required.
- [Pricing](https://skillar.ai/pricing) · [Book a demo](https://skillar.ai/demo) · [Manifesto](https://skillar.ai/about)

## Status

Pre-launch, onboarding design partners. SOC 2 Type II and SSO are on the
roadmap, not yet complete. Figures shown in product mockups are
illustrative examples, not live customer data.
